company.name: Senic
company.shortDescription: Senic is a Berlin-based hardware startup building the next evolution of smart home interfaces and systems.
company.description:
Senic is backed hardware startup building the next evolution of smart home interfaces and systems. 

Combining design and technology, Senic creates beautiful smart home experiences that put humans first. The company is tackling a >$50 Billion untapped market, along with the issue of designing for stickiness instead of the user's wellbeing. Senic's first product, Nuimo Control, was funded on Kickstarter in 32 hours, reaching > $500K in crowdfunding pre-sales. Senic products are based on electronics, mechanics, design, software and nano-technology.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,000,000, or 62.31% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,889,274 to $18,812,347, a 9.96x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
